card: One VR parity harness: shared bout builder, comparator and diff record
deviations_from_card: (1) Commit order: harness+conformance+drift, then vectors+docs, then the test commit last, so every commit is green (harness.test imports createContext and replayVector().diff, which only exist after both refactors); 142c3f4 verified green alone in a temp worktree (16/16 vr tests). (2) Case 5 uses a hermetic training-driver vector recorded from the PC kernel (dummy-wave shape) instead of a bolt-hit-shaped arena vector, so it runs without the VR checkout. (3) To keep every existing test and the JSON/text report unchanged, both results keep their legacy views: replayConformance returns diff {tick,when,field,detail} plus the new record (the shared Diff); replayVector keeps mismatch plus the new diff (the shared Diff). Both Diffs have exactly {tick,when,path,expected,actual,detail}. (4) Conformance bouts do not pass balance:'canonical' (critic caution): only difficulty:null.
notes: Red before: harness.test.mjs could not load (no harness.mjs, no createContext export) - all 6 red; 6/6 green after. Existing vr tests: 16/16 green unchanged (no existing test edited). Output diffs vs 290a90d: vr:vectors text byte-identical (1/1 pass); vr:vectors --json adds "diff": null per result. vr:drift --vectors: still 2/45 pass (reset-waves, tier-clock); exactly two lines changed, both games-driver vectors whose first diff reads a pace-dependent tick - duel-competence-1 'events[1].tick: expected 25 got 5' -> 'got 7', duel-competence-1-5 'events[2].tick: expected 28 got 5' -> 'got 7' (PC's first release event, tick 5 paced -> tick 7 unpaced). The other 5 games vectors (creature-bout, soldiers-bout, tiro-ladder, tiro-sequence, wave-reset) are unchanged (tick 0 actors[1].x). --json gains a 'record' key per result. The card's evidence said duel-competence-1-5 would move to events[4]; measured it stays at events[2] with a new tick. No kernel or vector file touched. VECTORS.md setup rows (difficulty, balance) now name the createGames options. Full `npm run gate` exits 2 three times on sibling in-flight files only (packages/core/src/arena/contact.test.ts, ledger.test.ts, ledger.ts tapContacts, packages/game/src/answers.test.ts - arena-kernel work), never on packages/tools/vr; the gate's other parts that cover my files were run directly and are green. B can build on harness.compare/POLICY/makeDiff/renderDiff and replayConformance(...).record.
